name: Virgin Money M Account for Business
description: No monthly charges and free basic transactions mean it won't quietly eat into your cashflow. You get everything you'd expect from a traditional bank — plus accounting software integration and an M-Track dashboard that saves real hours on admin.
verdict: Virgin Money's M Account is a solid all-rounder. No monthly charges and free basic transactions mean it won't quietly eat into your cashflow. The M-Track dashboard is a genuinely useful tool for keeping tabs on your business performance.
features: Track cashflow with the M-Track dashboard
Earn 0.25% cashback on debit card purchases
eligibility: Your business must turn over less than £1 million a year and be based in the UK (excluding Northern Ireland, the Channel Islands and the Isle of Man). You must be at least 18.
welcomePromo: 6 months free access to Xero accounting software when you open an account.
pros: Good for managing your money with the M-Track dashboard
cons: Free account only for companies with annual turnover under £1 million
No branches in the South of England, Wales or Northern Ireland

name: Tide Business Account — Free
description: Tide takes the pain out of managing payments. Charge customers via card reader, smartphone, payment links or the web — all from one place. Register a new limited company through Tide for just £24.99.
verdict: Tide takes the pain out of managing payments. If you're registering a new limited company, Tide can handle it for just £24.99 — significantly cheaper than Companies House. Free bank transfers for 12 months when you apply via NerdWallet.
features: Free bank transfers for 12 months when you apply via NerdWallet
Connect accounting software from QuickBooks, Sage and Xero
Save over £75 on new limited company registration
Take payments with card readers, payment links, tap to pay and more
Earn interest with a free Instant Saver Account
eligibility: You must be aged 18 or over and have a UK-based business.
welcomePromo: Free bank transfers for 12 months + £50 sign-up bonus for new Ledger users.
pros: Cashback and free bank transfers for 12 months
Earn interest with a free savings account
cons: No branches

name: Revolut Basic Business Account
description: If your business crosses borders, Revolut carries a lot of useful kit. Spend in over 150 currencies and exchange £1,000 per month at the interbank rate — charge customers and send payments across the globe from one place.
verdict: A strong pick if your business operates internationally. The interbank exchange rate on £1,000/month and 150+ currency support are genuinely useful. The monthly fee is the main drawback — and there's no FSCS protection.
features: Take payments via phone, card reader, web and more
Exchange £1,000 per month at the interbank rate
eligibility: Companies should be active and fully incorporated. Your legal home address should be in the UK, EEA, Switzerland, Australia, Singapore or the United States.
welcomePromo: 3 months free on the Scale plan when you open a new account.
cons: All accounts have a monthly fee
You cannot deposit cash or cheques
Accounts are not FSCS protected

name: Barclays Business Bank Account
description: Barclays gives you free basic transactions and no monthly fees for the first 12 months. Account holders can access savings on bookkeeping software, business insurance and more through Barclays's partner marketplace.
verdict: Barclays gives you free basic transactions and no monthly fees for the first 12 months, so your money stays in your business. The partner marketplace with savings on Meta, AWS and FreshBooks is a genuine bonus for growing businesses.
features: Save on business purchases from partners including Meta and AWS
eligibility: You must be 18 or above and have the right to live in the UK. Open to sole traders, freelancers, limited companies and more.
welcomePromo: 12 months free banking plus free access to FreshBooks accounting software.
pros: Free access to FreshBooks accounting software
cons: Monthly fee of £8.50 after the first year

name: Wallester Business Free Account
description: A fee-free account for managing expenses and issuing virtual debit cards. A genuinely strong alternative to traditional business banking for startups and digital-first teams that need scalable card management.
verdict: A fee-free account for managing expenses and issuing virtual debit cards — a genuinely strong alternative for startups and digital-first teams. If your business needs scalable card and expense management, Wallester is worth a look.
features: Global card use anywhere that accepts Visa
No monthly fees or setup costs
Real-time expense tracking and budget control tools
eligibility: UK, Swiss or EEA-registered businesses can apply.
welcomePromo: 300 free virtual cards included from day one, no setup costs.
pros: Issue hundreds of business expense cards instantly
Great for international and remote teams
Smart budgeting and expense management tools
cons: No overdraft or business loan options
Mobile app has mixed reviews
Not covered by the FSCS protection scheme

name: WorldFirst Business Account
description: If your business is breaking into new markets, WorldFirst is worth considering. Receive payments in over 20 currencies without charge, and send in over 100. No set-up or monthly fee, and there's a potential sign-up bonus on top.
verdict: If your business is about to break into new markets, WorldFirst carries serious weight. Receive payments in 20+ currencies for free, 0% FX fees on 15 currencies, and up to 1.2% cashback on card payments. No monthly fee.
features: Up to 1.2% cashback on card payments
eligibility: You must be 18 or above. Unlike many providers, you don't need a UK address.
welcomePromo: Potential $100 sign-up bonus for new account holders.
pros: Avoid foreign transaction fees in 15 currencies
cons: No overdraft facility
Some outgoing payments have fees
No FSCS protection

name: NatWest Start Up Business Account
description: NatWest's Startup Business Account gives you no monthly fees and free basic UK transactions for two years. That's a meaningful head start. You also get branches, a solid mobile app and free FreeAgent accounting software.
verdict: NatWest's Startup Account gives you no monthly fees and free basic UK transactions for two years. That's a meaningful head start for a new business. You also get branches, a solid mobile app and free accounting software.
features: No basic transaction fees for 2 years
Bank online, via app, over the phone or in branch
eligibility: For businesses that have been trading for less than 12 months, with turnover under £1 million, registered in the UK. One person on the application must be a UK resident. You must be 18 or older.
welcomePromo: 2 years of free banking plus free FreeAgent accounting software.
pros: Two years of free basic transactions
Manage accounts online, via app, branch, Post Office or phone
cons: No branches in Scotland or Northern Ireland

name: The Co-operative Bank Business Account
description: A no-fee business account from a bank with a genuine ethical policy. Free unlimited access to the Go Get Paid app, integration with Sage, Xero and QuickBooks, and overdraft access up to £250,000.
verdict: The only major UK bank with a published ethical policy that it actually applies. No monthly fee, free standard transactions, and an arranged overdraft facility up to £250,000. A strong choice if your values matter to your banking.
features: No monthly fee and no fee for basic transactions
Integrate accounting software from Sage, Xero and QuickBooks
Access to Clover payment terminals for £1 a month for the first 12 months
Free unlimited access to the Go Get Paid app
eligibility: Open to Limited Companies, Sole Traders, Partnerships and LLPs with up to 10 key individuals. All applicants must be 18 or over and UK residents.
welcomePromo: Clover payment terminals for just £1/month for your first 12 months.
cons: No branches in Northern Ireland

name: Monzo Lite Business Account
description: Monzo's Lite Account is a free business account with simple ways to pay — including in-person contactless. Around nine in 10 applications are accepted the same day. Digital receipts, transaction insights and 24/7 support come as standard.
verdict: Monzo's Lite Account is a free business account with simple ways to pay. Around nine in 10 applications are accepted the same day. Digital receipts, transaction insights and 24/7 customer support come as standard — all for free.
features: Fast set-up — most accounts open same day
Accept payments via smartphone or payment links
Earn interest on the money in your Instant Access Pots
eligibility: You must be a sole trader or director of a limited company. Open to UK businesses only.
welcomePromo: Same-day account opening for most customers — no waiting.
pros: Same-day account opening for most customers
Great app with genuinely helpful features
cons: No phone or branch banking
Not available to charities or partnerships
No accounting software integration on the Lite account

name: Lloyds Bank Business Account
description: If you value banking in branch and face-to-face customer support, Lloyds is a good shout. Branches right across England and Wales. No monthly fees for 12 months, 100 free outgoing electronic payments per month.
verdict: If you value banking in branch and face-to-face customer support, Lloyds is a good shout. Branches right across England and Wales, plus Halifax and Bank of Scotland branches in Scotland and Northern Ireland.
features: No account fee for the first year
100 free outgoing electronic payments per month
Custom access levels for other users
Bank online, via app, over the phone or in branch
eligibility: You must be at least 18, a UK resident, and have a UK mobile phone number. Open to sole traders and directors of limited companies with turnover under £25 million a year.
welcomePromo: 12 months free banking plus free accounting tools from day one.
cons: £8.50 monthly fee after the first year
Certain transactions have fees
